picks.thesis: Convergence across both filer types. Four House members — Fields and Cisneros (D), Letlow and Allen (R) — bought TSM in $1k–$15k bands from January through May 8. Then eleven insiders, including CEO Wei Che-Chia (~$11k) and Co-COO Mii Yuh-Jier, made non-10b5-1 open-market buys on 2026-06-05 and 6-22 (lag 1–4 days). Two independent signals reinforce each other and price holds the mid-upper range (+3.7% over 30 days). Tempering the read: the insider buys are tiny ($3k–$11k) and all fall on a single day, consistent with a routine program rather than discretionary conviction, and the congressional leg is now roughly two months stale.
key_risks: The eleven insider buys are small ($3k–$11k) and all dated 2026-06-05, consistent with a routine/programmatic purchase rather than discretionary conviction.
The congressional leg is stale — latest buy 2026-05-08, cluster spans Jan–May — and disclosed only in $1k–$15k bands, so true sizes are unknown.
No committee oversight alignment among the four buyers.
picks.invalidation: TSM insiders (especially CEO Wei) or the four members begin filing sales, or insider buying stops and price breaks back toward the 90-day low (340.96).
